brief:
UN humanitarians reported Tuesday that women-headed households in Gaza confront daily "impossible decisions" as Israeli airstrikes continue and essential resources remain scarce. The assessment underscores the particular vulnerability of families led by women in the conflict zone, where access to basic necessities has deteriorated sharply.

The crisis reflects broader humanitarian collapse across Gaza, where civilian populations struggle to obtain food, clean water, and medical care. Aid organizations have warned that conditions are worsening as the conflict persists, leaving vulnerable populations with few options to meet fundamental needs. UN officials did not provide specific figures on the number of women-headed households affected or detail which particular resources face the greatest shortages.
dek: In war-torn Gaza, a growing number of women-headed households face “impossible decisions” every day, amid ongoing Israeli airstrikes and still-scarce resources, UN humanitarians said on Tuesday.
title: Women-headed households in Gaza face impossible survival choices amid war
